scope: Execution-only repair. No biological constraint, threshold, estimator term, M_MIN, or desired retention fraction is changed.

control_primary_semantics.null_control: CONTROL_B only for control-vs-control anti-false-green analysis
control_primary_semantics.primary_retention_rule: A linked edge is retained in the primary only if CONTROL_A exists and passes every frozen gate. CONTROL_B may never rescue CONTROL_A.
control_primary_semantics.null_availability_rule: If CONTROL_A succeeds and CONTROL_B fails, retain the edge for the primary and mark the control-vs-control null unavailable for that edge.
control_primary_semantics.independent_draws: A and B use distinct deterministic sub-seeds and are drawn independently from the same edge-specific admissible distribution.
control_primary_semantics.coincidence_rule: A and B are NOT conditioned to be different. If independent draws coincide, record control_draws_coincident=true and do not redraw.

side_semantics.rule: For each control draw, choose side S in {+1,-1} first from its deterministic sub-seed, before evaluating side-specific admissibility.
side_semantics.no_retry: If the chosen side has no admissible start, that draw fails. Never retry on the opposite side.

exact_admissible_set.definition: For promoter midpoint P, linked source distance d0, tolerance tol=max(0.10*d0,10000), and pre-drawn side S, the final admissible start set A is the set of integer starts s satisfying ALL frozen rules: distance/side band, promoter-specific E2-distal exclusion, exact C3 hg19->hg38->hg19 identity, hg38 Nott PU.1 overlap, and hg38 NIH-CARD consensus-peak overlap.
exact_admissible_set.distance_band: Window midpoint m=s+2500 must have sign(m-P)=S and |m-P| in [d0-tol,d0+tol].
exact_admissible_set.promoter_specific_exclusion: The 5-kb window may not overlap any E2 distal partner of this promoter by >=1 bp. No genome-wide unrelated-promoter exclusion.
exact_admissible_set.C3: liftOver v479, minMatch=0.95, exactly one forward mapping, same chromosome, exact 5000-bp length, and exact reverse round-trip to the original hg19 interval; zero-base tolerance.
authoritative_biological_support: mapped hg38 control interval overlaps >=1 Nott PU.1 microglia ATAC peak
mapped hg38 control interval overlaps >=1 NIH-CARD consensus peak
exact_admissible_set.hg19_PU1_prefilter: FORBIDDEN unless a separately audited proof establishes exact lossless equivalence to the authoritative post-liftover hg38 PU.1 gate for the complete candidate universe. Matching interval counts is not such a proof.
exact_admissible_set.uniform_sampling: CONTROL_A/B are sampled uniformly over the integer starts in the FINAL admissible set A for their independently drawn side.

exact_computation_strategy.principle: No candidate lattice and no finite-draw rejection sampler may be used to decide whether A is empty.
exact_computation_strategy.permitted_primary_strategy: Use interval algebra over liftOver chain blocks to construct A exactly without enumerating every base.
required_steps: derive hg19 start intervals for which the entire 5-kb window lies inside a single valid forward chain mapping segment and maps as one exact 5-kb same-chromosome interval
intersect with reverse-chain validity so the mapped hg38 interval returns exactly to the original hg19 interval
within those exact-roundtrip mapping segments, transform hg38 PU.1-overlap and NIH-CARD-consensus-overlap constraints back to hg19 start intervals
intersect those intervals with the pre-drawn side/distance band
merge/disjoint-normalize integer intervals and compute their exact integer cardinality
sample one integer uniformly by cumulative cardinality, not by choosing intervals uniformly
exact_computation_strategy.alternative: Any alternative implementation is allowed only if independently demonstrated to produce exactly the same admissible integer set A on deterministic fixtures and sampled real-edge checks before the full run.
exact_computation_strategy.empty_set: If A is empty, report the draw failure as a result. Do not infer the design is wrong merely because the empty-set rate is high.

anchor_frequency.frozen_definition: For interval I, number of DISTINCT E2 promoter_keys with at least one E2 distal partner overlapping I by >=1 bp.
anchor_frequency.linked_and_control: Compute identically for linked, CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B intervals.

funnel_reporting.rule: Primary funnel retention is determined by LINKED support plus CONTROL_A only. CONTROL_B availability is reported separately and cannot change the primary denominator.

must_bind: liftOver binary and both chain-file digests

invariants: every retained control has exact C3 round-trip evidence
every retained control passes hg38 PU.1 and NIH-CARD peak support
stop_conditions: implementation cannot construct the exact admissible set defined above
round-trip or provenance evidence cannot be bound

governance.phase_B_matrix_reads: STOPPED until repaired Phase A is independently re-audited
